integrity: All verification scripts and recorded outputs are included. The infinite argument uses the published connected-cycle theorem plus disjoint-union congruence; no formal proof assistant certification or independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to ordinary first-order rank-four equivalence for finite simple undirected two-regular graphs; gives an infinite sufficient large-cycle regime and a sharp minimum disconnected witness, not the full classification of cycle-union theories. Finite exact checks are computational, with an additional direct game solver; historical priority beyond inspected sources is not exhaustively resolved.
title: The eighteen-vertex threshold for four-round indistinguishability of connectedness in cycle unions
